notes.title: Figurine Scene Simulator "Jumpstart" Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We're launching our "Jumpstart" Early Access release today.  You can install over 250 characters from 5 different franchises and try the out with the FSS features such as posing them with animations, setting up animation sequences, adding props and configuring realism effects including a look effect and chest animator.  

This is a very early cut of the game and does not include any of the gamification features or the advanced customization features we have planned for the next phases in the roadmap (along with many other character enhancement/quality features).  If you're interested in this early cut, we'd love for you to try out the game and give us some feedback, but if you're looking for a more finished product, please wait for one of the later releases which will be more mature and help guide you through using the game features better.

Thanks for your time!  We're excited to see what the community thinks - even if it's still a bit rough ;-)

Rez You Later,
-Arcade Player '99

notes.title: Early Access "Pre-Release" Launch Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hi All,

We've been buried in development and while we've been getting new features in, we haven't had a good build to update the demo with.  At this point, we're going to just drive the full game version until we can drop an Early Access "Pre-Release" with the core base game functionality.  

This is the current plan we're looking at kicking off later this month:


 Figurine Scene Simulator Early Access Pre-Release - this would include the base game functionality with 300+ characters across 9 different free DLC packs.

 Deluxe Unlock Update - Adds the deluxe unlock functionality to the game. With this release, the deluxe functionality will be available to try out for free, allowing to you select different color variants, turn on/off clothes components, and use facial expression and body blendshapes. While you can use the features for free during this time, we'll also offer a deeply discounted bundle in the store for people who want to purchase now to support the game development.  

(Each franchise will have its own moderately priced premium unlock so you only pay for the franchises you're interested in - the bundle will give a discount on purchasing all of them at once.)

 Ambient Channels Integration - We're currently working on a release of Ambient Channels which will allow you to download episodes individually (it will also include 6+ new episodes).  This FSS update will provide integration so you can open Ambient Channel episodes from Figurine Scene Simulator and drop your characters into rich environments.

 Full Early Access Release - In addition to several features we have planned for this release, we will also add another 100+ characters, but also make the deluxe unlock features available only if you've purchased the appropriate deluxe unlock DLC. We'll still have a big discount on the bundle, but it will be reduced from the Early Access Pre-Release discount.

 We'll provide more details on the Early Access roadmap once we hit this point.


Here's a link to the first (free) Franchise DLC pack:
Warrior Class Franchise


Thanks for your interest in Figurine Scene Simulator!

Rez you later,
Arcade Player 1999

notes.title: Demo Update - Gif Recording
notes.notes:
The latest update to the Figurine Scene Simulator pre-release demo is the ability to capture gifs.  It has a couple of different modes to allow you to grab an animation from start to finish or rotate the last active character and take a seamless loop capture.

The use the new feature, follow these steps:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/74f8ad0fde3a51bd407c7880a722be65766d4ccf.png
1. Create a new character, (optionally give it props, realism effects), choose an animation and then click the' Go To Producer' on the lower right radial menu.  (In the examples, we also have a frame and mood effect selected)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/5204b9d0ba9c6624f2da08188ca9ffc67b71100d.png
2. While in Producer mode, open the Gif Recorder by clicking on the 'Gif Capture' button on the top right radial menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/ea33f1fe78e349d6c87e0d3d52704c8312288de4.png
3. Click the 'Recording Details' button to select different recording options.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/db39299bffc9f2987862198b3685aae82b4ce0d0.png
4. Click the 'Set Duration To Animation Length' button to sync the recording duration to the animation length of the last active character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/e156b7b83608254705d86c930c34f5fff2df7b76.png
5. Toggle the "Sync Animation On Record" slider in order to have the recorder reset the animation when recording starts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/a6fecdb4adf2ab71311cae8d7f5c2efc57173359.png
6. Click the 'Resolution' button and select a resolution. 

Note: Each frame is it's own gif capture, so a large resolution will cause the file size and saving time to add up fast. If you need under the file to be under 5MB, you'll want to go with 384x216.  1280x720 is a good medium desktop resolution, and 1920x1080 is usually the max desktop resolution unless you have a high end machine.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/d123e5b37a44af0a271b09264e48e1caf5f92909.png
7. Click the 'Record' button to start recording.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/9a8959846b8d433c30b5dfe22dec637d642ac438.png
(The UI will disappear during recording)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/6f79d67b49a90317534ccf0c8aa779ed27ffc264.png
8. After recording is complete, click the 'Save' button to save it to the output folder. (You can change the output folder in the Recording Details drop down)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/e0cee068fec31f1c3e2d80143dc6ab2cfbab1c23.png
9. The status will show on the Gif Recorder bar.  When it's been saved, you can click the Recording Details button, and then the 'Open Gif Recording Folder' button to open the folder the gif was saved to.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/1035f29f060245b52f7ec31a2dcf4a46c711fcb0.gif
Gif Capture 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/1e4bae419e33eab5076bc6556e7271f49f6c503b.png
10.  After the Gif is saved, click the Reset button if you want to record another gif.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/ab184d5ae350ced59ba24aa78a1fc3902ef5d9a8.png
11. Another mode will rotate the last character during recording.  Click the 'Recording Mode' button and then the 'Character Rotate' button on the drop down.  You can then click the 'Record' button on the main bar to record a new gif.  After, save the image like last time.

(The 'Animation' mode will sync the recording duration to the animation and reset the animation when recording starts automatically without setting the options under details)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/063bbb3a0db6ba2b327863fd12041837490020b8.gif
Character Rotation Mode

Higher Resolution Versions:

 1280x720
 1920x1280
 3840x2160



Thanks for your time!

Arcade Player '99

notes.title: Demo Update - Procedural Animators, Look
notes.notes:
Hello all,

We're adding three realism animators for the first early access release. The second one is a look animator (the previous one was a female chest animator and the next one is an eye animator). You can try out the new feature in the demo with the following steps:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/5fdbcf8e411d829667122cae7e2fa9fdab9a91ab.png
1. Add Character  (All humanoid characters should support the look animator, we'll be adding support for dragons, etc for the early access release)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/ace73701e084f27dbb4bbaf43d015d20a0ee6bad.png
2. With the character added to the scene, click the Animation & Poses button on the bottom left radial menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/841f8133be00ff12228c219d7a0c1fd6f9030e0b.png
3. Go to Realism Effects on the updated bottom left radial menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/28fee5179c33a4a1d082a4ab5e5e1122be78cd4e.png
4. Select the Look animator from the list and then click the enable button on the top left radial menu. (The character will be temporarily placed in a T pose so the neck can be calculated correctly.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/5fe7586a5e344742ca6f66ece7ba662306d66d7c.png
5. Once enabled, you can adjust the settings.  The Additional Bones setting allows you to add spine members to increase the amount of bones engaged in turning.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/e655547d6fa5cca41d4851b6b9f86e1fba25276e.png
6. You can switch the look target to an Attached Point, which moves with the character.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/1a78839e1b68ac83c061ff9367eb19c4d8be8055.png
7. Or Fixed Point which can be placed anywhere in the room without being affected by the character travel.

Thanks for your time!  The Eye Animator will be posted in the next day or two.

Arcade Player '99

7. You can change the "realism" of the effect by modifying the adjusters on the Procedural Chest menu.  (The changes are subtle per slider, tooltips will be provided in the release)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/2956dcaa455f1eede5324e6b963d8b8c2eefc622.gif
8. After changing sliders, click the update button in order for the changes to take effect. 


Thanks for your time, up next: Eyes and Look animators! (in test now)
Arcade Player '99

notes.title: Demo update - Speech Bubbles
notes.notes:
Hi All,

The latest updates adds a new feature that let's you add Dialog / Speech Bubbles to characters.  Here's the process to try it out:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/298c7a28fe8810932de4ec76e73de86cfcda96d4.png
Select a character and then click the Add Character button on the top right radial menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/b3c176df4580e9228f8dae0abccbafb1261ab009.png
With the character selected, click the Dialog Editor button on the bottom left radial menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/3e096e11834b61ebb6d26a795e88564474cd3329.png
Click the Add Dialog button on the top left radial menu.

Note: You cannot move around the scene when editing a dialog.  If you want to, just save the dialog, move as normal and then click on the dialog to open the editor again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/c3d625e243b7de60fa3018320812621cfa59520e.png
Set the dialog options and text.  If you click on the Dialog Mood or Dialog Size buttons, it will open a drop down and allow you to set the mood and size.   (Example dialogs will disappear after a few seconds)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/86b6577bd9fe31b330b2daf3d8535e88cbb75da6.png
When happy, click the Save Dialog button on the top left radial menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/d3b88580de9eb49982945ed440016e9ce717d87f.png
To activate the dialog, click on it from the list for the character.  It will automatically open the editor and will keep the dialog active.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/3275ea12f2eef66926d902fae8a72cda94a76cee.png
You can click the Close Editor button on the top left radial menu and the editor will close and the dialog will remain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/4cdd0cc750ef4ed71e4cc1e95b1ae9a9c894ba6e.png
If you want to close the dialog, close the dialog editor and then click the Close Dialogs button.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/cb05d6a6321d6eb9acc3c0f87a5bae918a54854e.png
You can close the character and the speech bubble will continue to appear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/e81235e134fadd5f3789568a84ad0574893acf13.png
You can go into the producer mode and create an image.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41060711/ef56e42fa4f36966d7f7f4ee145d6bd7d54a3bc5.png
Thanks for reading! (Next up is a look animator)

notes.title: Demo - Initial Release
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Thanks for taking a moment to look at our upcoming game, Figurine Scene Simulator.  We've recently released our initial starting point Demo and plan to expose our feature development by releasing regular demo updates.  

A quick back note - we had quite a few features nearing completion running up to getting our demo ready for Next Fest when we ran into GPU texture memory issues trying to create a Unity game with very large sets of high definition characters.  The finding required a 6-8 week refactoring process to the figurine system to use Unity's bundle system to give the game the ability to control when to load and unload textures, etc.

Anyway, If all goes well, now that the re-architecture is completed, ideally the rest of the features will be able to be onboarded fairly easily over the next few weeks and new demo releases will expose those updates.  (The demo currently has a large size to provide a broad set of characters, the download which will probably churn during this phase of development, please wait until launch if you'd like a more stable experience). 

Our upcoming demo update plan includes:

LUTs and Picture Frames
Adjustable Character Lighting / Pedestal
Character Props
Character Components
Scene/Prop FX
Additional post processing

After that, we'll focus on the final release features including:

Locking in the release characters
(If there's interest, we could put out a "beta" early access release to make the game available with most of the the launch day characters)
Adding the figurine -> character save system 
Game Settings
Break up bundle install to be user controlled by selecting from individual (free) DLC through the game.

At this point, there will be a feature freeze and only bugs will be resolved until the game's Early Access launch.

Please hit up discussions if you have any questions or feedback, thanks!

Arcade Player '99
